title: Generate Runes From My Project and Add Them

steps.intent: start a Claude Bare tab on an unlocked vault, open Runes and press Modify
press Add Local Files, tick the project's files I want turned into runes and pick a model and effort
press Generate and wait until the progress card reads Done
press Add to Vault on the Done line
press Done and check the generated runes are listed in this tab's vault, and that no other vault or launcher row changed
